page.notes: The first lines are partly covered by a dark ink blot over "purget" and the start of "pellit". Read as "pellit" and "purget", but the letters under the blot are uncertain. "Idenim" is printed without a space; copied as printed. The final word "inventiones" is followed by a stray mark that may be a period or a printer's dot; copied as "nes." with the line ending as printed. Faint marks at the bottom right corner are a digitiser or scan edge and are not transcribed.
